title: Private House Design 160 m², Munich | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 160 m² private house in Munich: design project, 3D visualization, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Private house interior design project, Munich, Germany, 160 m²

blocks.text: Private house interior design project, Munich, Germany, 160 m²

parts.html: In this project, the DUMSKAYA DESIGN interior design studio (Bratislava, Slovakia) delivered the full scope of work: interior design, technical documentation, the design and manufacture of custom furniture, and a turnkey renovation. The design covered every room: the living room, bedroom, a kitchen with custom interior fittings and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, the entrance hall, bathroom, wardrobes, and shelving. Furniture was custom-designed for each area. Before the renovation began, the client received a detailed cost estimate for labor, building materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, light fixtures, and more.
Shown here are 3D visualizations and photos of the completed project.
